# TEX & TEX - Dubai Property Data

> Free, openly licensed Dubai real estate data computed from Dubai Land Department open records.
> Published by TEX & TEX Real Estate, a licensed Dubai brokerage (BRN 58873). Rebuilt daily. Last update: 2026-09-17.

## What is here
- 113,598 registered residential sales in 2026, median AED 199,802 per sqft, median price AED 1,400,000
- 494,092 registered Ejari tenancy contracts, median annual rent AED 69,300
- 131 districts, 400 buildings, gross rental yields, lease expiries, daily reports

## Key pages
- /areas/ - every Dubai district: sales, median prices, rents, yields
- /prices/ - median sale price by bedroom count and district
- /rents/ - registered Ejari rents by district
- /yields/ - gross rental yield by district
- /projects/ - building league table and per-building sold prices
- /expiry/ - tenancy contracts expiring in the next 90 days, by district and building
- /reports/ - daily registered sales
- /luxury/ - AED 5M+ market and top sales
- /downloads/ - all data as CSV, plus /data/dubai.json (full machine-readable dump)

## Citation
Cite as: TEX & TEX Real Estate, Dubai Property Data, computed from Dubai Land Department open records, 2026-09-17, https://data.tex.ae
Underlying records: Dubai Land Department, published under the Dubai Open Data Licence. TEX & TEX is not affiliated with or endorsed by the DLD.

## Method
Medians, never averages. Residential sales only, filtered to value >= AED 100,000 and registered area between 9 and 3,000 sqm.
Rents are registered Ejari contracts, AED 5,000 to 50,000,000 annual. Gross yield = median rent per sqft / median sale price per sqft, same district, same period.
The DLD open feed contains no unit numbers and no personal data; neither does this site.
